approvals.note: Approved under Leif's standing bug-fix rule (coordinator chat, 2026-11-10): bug fixes may run the full lifecycle and squash-merge when CI is green and threads are resolved. Recorded by claude-code (Claude Opus 5.5, hc t37f). Makes behavior match REQ-change-013; no requirement text.

approved_scope.title: Commit identities from change records are used only as full commit ids
approved_scope.description: commit identities from change records are used only as full commit ids
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Makes behavior match REQ-change-013 (persisted workspace values are validated before use); the change spec only lists a new test file
acceptance_criteria: A change's base commit, verification and scoped-review commits, and bootstrap and reopening anchors read from records reach Git as revisions only when they are full commit ids, after --end-of-options; a recorded base that is not one makes the coverage gate fall back to the no-record base instead of failing

answers.constraints: REQ-change-013: reject untrusted or corrupt persisted workspace identity before using it; specsync diff already passes its base after --end-of-options
